name: Rectangle
description: Rectangle configures Sparkle with an HTTPS feed and a pinned SUPublicEDKey, and its app delegate starts the standard updater and exposes manual and automatic checks. Runtime signature enforcement remains delegated to Sparkle; this snapshot does not reverify the historical release.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; Sparkle's dependency-level verifier and historical release artifact signing were not independently reverified.
